scope: Application code only. No private songs, reference audio, stems, recordings, exports or Ableton projects are included.
implemented: Local Bridge honors selected stems instead of importing every stem
Older Bridges are explicitly blocked from selected-only imports they cannot honor
Local and cloud imports check reported track positions, counts and names
Import status and operation receipts persist on reference storage across backend workers and restarts
Browser retries retain an operation identifier; concurrent matching requests do not dispatch another import
Interrupted or ambiguous music writes require inspection, not automatic replay
Known preflight failures are distinguished from potentially partial music writes
Reference deletion cannot remove an active or unresolved import's recovery record
Browser reload displays the saved import outcome without repeating the music write

validation.browser: Mocked local/cloud APIs at 1440px and 390px: consent and saved interruption survive reload without another import; not a real Ableton remix test
validation.ci_postgres: Not yet run for this candidate

full_release_blockers: Reference-bound remix intent and retained/replaced layers are not yet implemented as a complete product flow
Tempo/warp and pitch changes are not implemented and verified across all imported stems
Arrangement audio-stem replacement is not implemented as a non-destructive, source-identity-checked operation
Ambiguous import outcomes stop safely but still need exact clip/file reconciliation and a user-facing recovery path
Import verification currently checks track receipts and names, not exact audio identity and full clip timing
The frontend-to-Ableton remix and complete export path has not passed real end-to-end acceptance
New Bridge source has not been packaged, signed, notarized or validated for automatic update
deployment: No production deployment or installer publication performed for this candidate. Do not present passing unit tests as a completed remix release.
